meta.name: graph-query
meta.description: Use when the user asks a question about how things in the codebase or wiki relate — what connects two things, how something works end to end, what depends on what, or what a concept means in this repo. Answers from the knowledge graph in graphify-out/graph.json, with source-location citations. Trigger on "/graph-query", "ask the graph", "what connects X to Y", "trace how X works", "explain <concept> from the graph", "shortest path between".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱查询代码库和文档中的关联关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要理清代码库或文档中概念间的关联关系
copy.tagline_en: Query relationships in codebase and wiki using a knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to trace connections between concepts in your codebase or documentation

howto.what: 当用户询问代码库或 wiki 中事物之间的关系时，Claude 会从知识图谱中提取答案，并附上来源位置引用。它只回答图谱中已有的信息，不会编造。
howto.when: 当用户提到“/graph-query”、“ask the graph”、“what connects X to Y”等关键词，或询问两个事物如何关联、某个概念的含义时触发。
howto.what_en: When the user asks about relationships in the codebase or wiki, Claude answers from the knowledge graph with source-location citations. It only uses what the graph contains and never invents edges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "/graph-query", "ask the graph", "what connects X to Y", etc., or asks how two things relate, traces a flow, or explains a concept from the graph.

say_en.text: what connects the intake flow to the billing module?
say_en.note: Claude finds connections between the two modules with citations.

say_en.text: trace how a wiki capture becomes a committed entry.
say_en.note: Claude follows the graph path and shows each step with references.

say_en.text: explain the WAT execution model from the graph.
say_en.note: Claude explains the concept and its neighbors based on the graph.
